about_the_game:
In the depths of the distant universe, a sudden disaster takes you to a strange planet full of unknowns and dangers. As the only survivor in the mission, you must rely on your own wisdom and courage to resist wave after wave of alien creatures until reinforcements arrive. In this unfamiliar land, survival is no longer a choice, but the only goal.

■ Game features

Automatic shooting: The weapon fires automatically.

Fast paced battles: Each battle brings a thrilling and intense gaming experience.

■ Diverse character selection: 46 characters to choose from, including one handed weapon expert, berserker attacker, lucky one, mage, etc., to create your own unique combat style.

Rich weapons and props: Hundreds of weapons and props for you to choose from, from flamethrowers, submachine guns, rocket launchers to staffs and stones, everything is available.

Diverse Enemy Attack Waves: Each wave of enemy attacks lasts for 20 to 90 seconds, challenging your survival limits.

Upgrade and store system: Upgrade by picking up experience and go to the store to purchase items during enemy attacks to enhance combat effectiveness.

Custom difficulty settings: You can adjust the enemy's health, damage, and speed to create the most suitable survival challenge for you.

In 'Bloody Alien', survival is not just a goal, but also a glorious battle. Pick up your weapon, embrace the challenge, and write your own heroic legend!

content_descriptors.notes:
The game includes behaviors such as shooting with firearms and cutting with swords and knives.
Has a certain degree of bloody violence.

short_description: A top-down arena shooting light Roguelike game. Players take on the role of a modified warrior who is caught up in a black hole and forced to land on an unknown planet. Faced with hordes of alien monsters and uncontrollable mechanical debris
supported_languages: English, French, German, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal
